name: Freemelt Holding AB (publ)
summary: Freemelt Holding AB (publ), operating through its subsidiary Freemelt AB, focuses on metal 3D-printing technology across Europe, Asia, and North America. The company is responsible for the production, distribution, and servicing of Freemelt ONE, an advanced electron beam-based 3D printer developed specifically for research and development purposes. Its clientele primarily consists of universities, various research institutions, and the R&D divisions within large enterprises. The company was founded in 2017 and has its principal office situated in Mölndal, Sweden.
